access_method: Official Stack Exchange API v2.3 for public questions only; HTML scraping is excluded.
authentication: Optional application key supplied through an environment variable; user OAuth and access tokens are excluded from the smoke.
rate_limit: Respect wrapper backoff globally for the questions method, preserve quota fields, and stop before the frozen quota reserve.
allowed_usage: Internal demand research and derived source-quality analysis of public questions only; no user contact, profiling, spam, or personal-information sale.
raw_text_retention: Normalized public question text is retained local-only; raw owner identifiers, display names, profile URLs, credentials, and full API payloads are not retained.
redistribution: Only attributed derived metrics, source URLs, timestamps, content licenses, and fingerprints may be shared; raw question bodies are not redistributed.
deletion_handling: Remove locally retained text when a question disappears during refresh or upon a valid removal request; retain only non-reversible aggregate metrics when appropriate.
attribution: Every observation retains Stack Exchange as the source, the canonical source URL, and the API content_license value for attribution.
robots_or_automated_access_policy: Official Stack Exchange API only; no HTML scraping, and all API quota and backoff instructions are mandatory.
